annotation_representation.expected_phone: <SIL> placeholder; not a canonical expected phone

clean_addition_rule.observed_phone_canonical: one of the frozen 40 canonical phones

source_level_exclusions: tagged addition whose resolved relation is unresolved
expected raw token other than sil
unknown, malformed, noncanonical, or non-speech observed phone
non-finite or non-positive interval for detailed event analysis

runtime_word_eligibility.word_rows: no unresolved or malformed row in the word
runtime_word_eligibility.runtime_span: reliable frozen MFA word boundary available

expected_sequence.requirements: clean row with canonical expected phone

boundary.formula: count expected-sequence rows with source_index less than the addition source_index

binary_word_labels.positive: eligible runtime word contains at least one clean mapped addition event
binary_word_labels.negative: eligible runtime word contains zero clean mapped addition events
binary_word_labels.correct_only_negative: negative with zero substitutions and zero deletions
binary_word_labels.substitution_negative: negative with at least one substitution; may overlap deletion-negative
binary_word_labels.deletion_negative: negative with at least one deletion; may overlap substitution-negative

mixed_and_multiple.addition_plus_substitution: retain positive word and flag cohort
mixed_and_multiple.addition_plus_deletion: retain positive word and flag cohort
mixed_and_multiple.multiple_additions: retain word and every true event
